A place where children learn.

Example: I go to school by bus.
cards.say: school. I go to school by bus.

cards.back:

Bahasa Indonesia: guru
Example: My teacher is kind.
cards.say: teacher. My teacher is kind.

cards.back:
A person who learns at school.
Bahasa Indonesia: murid
Example: The student reads a book.
cards.say: student. The student reads a book.

cards.back:
The room where you learn.
Bahasa Indonesia: ruang kelas
Example: Our classroom is clean.
cards.say: classroom. Our classroom is clean.

A table where you write at school.
Bahasa Indonesia: meja
Example: My book is on the desk.
cards.say: desk. My book is on the desk.

cards.back:
You sit on it.
Bahasa Indonesia: kursi
Example: Sit on the chair, please.
cards.say: chair. Sit on the chair, please.

Pages with words and pictures to read.
Bahasa Indonesia: buku
Example: I read a funny book.

Bahasa Indonesia: pensil
Example: I have a yellow pencil.

Example: My school bag is blue.

Example: The teacher writes on the board.

Thin sheets you write or draw on.
Bahasa Indonesia: kertas
Example: I draw on white paper.

A coloured stick for drawing.
Bahasa Indonesia: krayon

Example: I draw a picture of a cat.

Bahasa Indonesia: membaca
Example: I read a story.

Example: I write my name.

cards.back:
To make a picture with a pencil.
Bahasa Indonesia: menggambar
Example: I draw a big sun.
cards.say: draw. I draw a big sun.

Example: Listen to the teacher.

Example: The English lesson is fun.
